svg.aria-label: Functional Diagram: What the learner and parent experience, and which functions produce it: persona, learner model, per-child teaching plan.
svg.text: SESSION ARC (what the child goes through)
Child can say “I don’t know”, “explain it differently”, “I think you’re wrong”; the tutor responds without shaming and changes representation, not just wording.
Fixed identity composed by code; same character every session.
Hard rules H1–H13 are always in the system instruction.
Voice: Gemini Live (Puck). Board: guided chalkboard with pictures,
Can pause the lesson to answer, then resume_lesson.
Bayesian knowledge tracing: provisional mastery needs pKnown ≥ 0.80
Evidence ladder L0–L5: levels of demonstrated understanding.
Strategy profile: Beta(α,β) per concept type × representation; avoid after
≥ 3 uses with mean < 0.3; decays 0.9 per 30 days.
Compiled from the learner model before every session by rules
R-REP, R-AVOID, R-SCAFFOLD, R-DIFF, R-FAST, R-PACE,
Speaks and listens; calls guided-board tools and
Read the child’s explanation; write a structured assessment and the
Claim validator and parent-report validator reject unsupported
statements before anything is saved or shown.
Plan card first (what the next sessions will do and why).
No scores or jargon; the parent can dispute a recorded
Demo: Leo’s mix-up “−5 > −1” is shown with its evidence.
Teacher: not modelled as a user in the docs. The product is positioned as teacher + AI companion; classroom teaching stays with the teacher.
Out of scope for this view: content ingest (diagram 05c) and deployment (diagram 08).
What the learner and parent experience, and which functions produce it: persona, learner model, per-child teaching plan.
